reason: E1 shows that an annealed HEA film forms a dense oxide and exhibits improved tribocorrosion resistance with lower ΔOCP and wear rate, directly supporting the role of a stable oxide. E3 indicates that microalloying (B) can enhance passive film stability and corrosion resistance, supporting the intervention premise. However, no cited evidence supports the claim that the high-entropy microstructure specifically promotes rapid oxide reformation and adhesion between sliding events, which is a key mechanistic premise.

The high-entropy microstructure promotes rapid reformation and adhesion of this oxide film between sliding events
